name: steer@8
after: steer@7 (PR 1815): its rule for profiles, methods, budget, tier 2 and held-out prompts; 64 training prompts (steer@5's 32 plus 32 new); a new model; the profiles are drawn by steer@7's rule and seed from this round's design after training
profiles: drawn after training: the midpoint of two design points that meet tier 2, steer@7's seed 71, 16 profiles
score: minus the largest absolute log10 change error over the four concepts, against the zero design on the same prompts

methods.gmoo: each cell as globalMOO queries on steer@5's trained model: every concept within tol of its target (an absolute band), uniq and coh at least the tier, drift at most drift_max; tol starts at the smaller of start_tol and tighten x the best design point's miss, and is multiplied by tighten whenever a query meets it, until the cell has used budget evaluations or a query ends without meeting it
methods.additive: steer@3's additive model from steer@5's band lines; each cell solved on the model by differential evolution on minus the score plus a steep penalty outside the cell, the answer evaluated, the model shifted by the residual and solved again, budget evaluations per cell
methods.de: differential evolution on the same loss at tier 2, de_maxiter generations of 24, per profile
methods.lookup: the best point of steer@5's design of experiments

claims.precision_heldout: on the held-out prompts, globalMOO's mean worst miss over the 16 profiles is below steer@7's 0.49 log10
claims.model: over the 16 profiles on the held-out prompts, globalMOO's worst miss is smaller than the additive model's in more profiles than it is larger; de and lookup are reported whichever way they fall
claims.precision: reported: profiles within log10(1.5) on every concept, training and held-out, for every method
